title: Wayland: incorrect screen_get_usable_rect() with mixed-resolution monitors
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.8-dev3, 4.7, 4.6, 4.5

### System information

OS: CachyOS Desktop: KDE Plasma 6.7.3 Session: Wayland CPU Intel i5-8600K Godot: 4.7.1

### Issue description

DisplayServer.screen_get_usable_rect() reports the wrong usable height for the 2560×1440 display. It reports 1048 Y, when it should report 1408.

KWin's MaximizeArea reports:
DP-2: 2560x1408
DP-3: 1920x1048

Monitors:
DP-2: 2560x1440 @ 100%, position +1920+0
DP-3: 1920x1080 @ 100%, position +0+0

Both monitors have a 32px KDE panel at the bottom.

This appears to be specific to Wayland as running in an X11 session does not have this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

Start up a new project, add a Node2D, run the below script on the _ready function

for i in DisplayServer.get_screen_count():
	print("Screen", i)
	print("position:", DisplayServer.screen_get_position(i))
	print("size:", DisplayServer.screen_get_size(i))
	print("usable:", DisplayServer.screen_get_usable_rect(i))

I see:
Screen0
position:(1920, 0)
size:(2560, 1440)
usable:[P: (1920, 0), S: (2560, 1048)]
Screen1
position:(0, 0)
size:(1920, 1080)
usable:[P: (0, 0), S: (1920, 1048)]

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Open the project and run it, just the output for the usable size

[BugTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31027696/BugTest.zip)
